title: Every maintenance state change is recorded (no audit screen in v1)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. An asset enrolled on a schedule (standard enrolment steps).
  3. Your user also holds "Settings Service" (for the schedule steps).
custom_steps:
1. Perform each change in turn: enter a mileage reading; Mark complete then Undo; Skip; add a compliance record; enrol; Remove from schedule; edit, archive and restore a schedule; Send reminder; Mark complete with "Completed elsewhere" and a shop name.
  2. After each change check its visible effect on screen.
  3. Look in the product for any screen that lists maintenance audit entries.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every change completes and its effect shows where the case for that action says (reading card, badge, Skipped state, record line, worklist row, last sent).
  • No screen lists the audit entries in this release.
  • That each change wrote an entry with an actor and a timestamp, and that the completion recorded where it happened, cannot be checked by hand in v1 — no screen shows the audit; it is for a developer or automated check. Pass or fail on what you can see, and write "audit not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10576 (S21, The audit trail), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S21 (S21-R1, S21-R3, S21-N3); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 10 Requirement Traceability, S21 row; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S21-R1: “Every state change produces an entry with an actor and a timestamp: readings, corrections, completions and their undo, skips, compliance record changes, cycle-date corrections in the step after invoicing, enrolments, removals from a schedule, schedule edits, archive and restore, and sends”
  • S21-N3: “No screen shows the audit in v1. Every entry is recorded from release, and a screen to read them follows later”
  • S21-R3: “A completion will record where it happened, including when that is another shop”
